name: pyyahoo
description: Read Yahoo Finance prices and fundamentals from the command line, powered by the pyyahoo CLI

interface.shortDescription: Read Yahoo Finance prices and fundamentals
interface.longDescription: Fetch a symbol's OHLCV price history or its current fundamentals snapshot from Yahoo Finance via the pyyahoo CLI. Works for US stocks (AAPL), Korean tickers (005930.KS), and indices (^GSPC).
defaultPrompt: Get the price history for AAPL
